summary.short: Brazil's general personal data protection law (LGPD) governs processing of personal data by public and private actors, where processing occurs in Brazil, targets people in Brazil, or data was collected there. It sets legal bases, data subject rights, controller and processor duties, international transfer rules, and ANPD sanctions.
summary.long: The LGPD (Law 13.709/2018) regulates processing of personal data, including in digital media, by natural and legal persons, public or private. Art. 3 covers processing carried out in Brazil, processing aimed at offering goods or services to people located in Brazil, and data collected there; Art. 4 excludes purely personal, journalistic, artistic, academic, public-security and defence uses. It sets legal bases (Art. 7), rules for sensitive, anonymised and children's data (Arts. 11–14), and data subject rights, including review of decisions made solely by automated processing (Arts. 18–22). Public bodies and international transfers are covered in Arts. 23–36. Controllers and operators face duties on records, impact reports, a data protection officer, liability, security and governance programmes (Arts. 37–51). Art. 52 provides administrative sanctions: warnings, fines of up to 2% of Brazilian revenue capped at R$50 million per infraction, publicising, blocking and deletion of data, and partial suspension or prohibition. Chapter IX creates the national authority (ANPD), later described as an agency, and a national council. Entry into force was phased under Art. 65.

I - dado pessoal: informação relacionada a pessoa natural identificada ou identificável
II - dado pessoal sensível: dado pessoal sobre origem racial ou étnica, convicção religiosa, opinião política
III - dado anonimizado: dado relativo a titular que não possa ser identificado
IV - banco de dados: conjunto estruturado de dados pessoais, estabelecido em um ou em vários locais
V - titular: pessoa natural a quem se referem os dados pessoais que são objeto de tratamento
VI - controlador: pessoa natural ou jurídica, de direito público ou privado, a quem competem as decisões referentes ao tratamento de dados pessoais
VII - operador: pessoa natural ou jurídica, de direito público ou privado, que realiza o tratamento de dados pessoais em nome do controlador
